name: Telangana ePASS · fresh registration
applicationPath: Post-matric scholarship · fresh registration · general case
coverage: Name and DOB comparison, income-certificate date, declared document status, and the published ePASS photo-size constraint.
limitations: This is not complete portal coverage. Renewal, course, caste, disability, domicile, and institution-specific conditions are not enabled.
The bank-account exception is surfaced as a conditional review, not inferred as a universal pass.
The source page does not establish document authenticity, identity, eligibility, sanction, or approval.

sources.title: Official scholarship portal and fresh-registration prerequisites
sources.section: Post Matric Scholarship Fresh Registration / eligibility and required documents
sources.note: The current official portal page lists a 2026–27 fresh-registration path, an income certificate obtained after 01-04-2025, and an EBC bank-account exception. The selected pack intentionally stores only those supported conditions.

sources.title: Required-document upload fields
sources.note: The current form labels the passport photograph as JPG only with a maximum size of 30 KB, and the bank-passbook first page as JPG only with a maximum of 100 KB. It does not define a universal pixel dimension or a full image-authenticity rule.

sources.title: Renewal guidance requires a current source check
sources.section: Eligibility navigation; linked legacy page unavailable at review
sources.note: The portal links a legacy eligibility page that returned HTTP 404 during release review. No current attendance threshold is asserted here. Confirm department- and cycle-specific renewal conditions through the official portal.

sources.title: Application Status service
sources.note: The portal exposes an Application Status service, but its exact internal status vocabulary is not asserted here. FeeSafe status labels are student-entered editorial categories that require confirmation against the portal.

imageConstraints.label: ePASS photo · maximum 30 KB
imageConstraints.limitation: Only the byte limit is source-backed here. No universal pixel dimensions or authenticity check is claimed.
